cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: A gives B permission to inspect a contract already signed while instructing B to add retrospective endorsement.
confusable: The superiority must shape how approval is sought, rather than disappear when A needs consent.
comparison: A paid performance booking differs from the other alternative's completed paint alteration.
seedUse: Canonical D04-b supplies prior commitment and a bargain for yes; S01-b supplies superiority despite needing another's cooperation. New booking setting is locally authored.
